subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should credential reveal state be ephemeral and masked-by-default per field, or may OpenClaw persist visibility preferences across sessions/platforms?
rationale: The useful UX request is clear, but the proposed persistent clear-text preference changes how credentials can be exposed on shared, streamed, or recorded devices.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Implement per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility state across sessions.

options.title: Persist Visibility Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence of reveal state after maintainers explicitly accept the credential exposure tradeoff and define reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the existing partial web behavior and defer native/platform work until a full sensitive-field inventory is owned.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Implement per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility state across sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this exact issue and has recent adjacent macOS and Control UI login-gate context.
